parts:
可以。下面我按 **APA 风格**把表格扩展成“论点—证据—引用格式—URL”的版本。注意：最强的一条是 Goettling et al. 2024，因为它直接把 zero perturbation 称为 **“frequently used scheme of setting values zero”**，并指出会造成 sudden jumps to zero / noise。citeturn432817view0turn432817view1

| 论点 | 证据/用途 | 引用格式 | URL |
|---|---|---|---|
| ECG perturbation-based XAI 中直接使用 zero-masking / setting-to-zero | Paralič et al. 在 12-lead ECG 的 perturbation explanation 方法中明确写道：被扰动区间的 values “are set to zero”。适合支撑“ECG 扰动解释中存在 zero-masking 实践”。citeturn466707view2 | Paralič, J., Kolárik, M., Paraličová, Z., Lohaj, O., & Jozefík, A. (2023). *Perturbation-Based Explainable AI for ECG Sensor Data*. **Applied Sciences, 13**(3), 1805. https://doi.org/10.3390/app13031805 | https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/13/3/1805 |
| zero-masking / setting-to-zero 是 ECG XAI 中 frequently used 的扰动方案 | Goettling et al. 明确称其为 “frequently used scheme of setting values zero”，这是支持“常用”的最直接文献。但它支持的是 **frequently used**，不是严格统计意义上的 **most common**。citeturn432817view0 | Goettling, M., Hammer, A., Malberg, H., et al. (2024). *xECGArch: A trustworthy deep learning architecture for interpretable ECG analysis considering short-term and long-term features*. **Scientific Reports, 14**, 13122. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-63656-x | https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-63656-x |
| zero-masking 会引入 hard-boundary / out-of-distribution artifacts | Goettling et al. 指出 setting values to zero 会引入 noise，因为模型并未在包含 “sudden jumps to zero” 的数据上训练；这直接支持你句子里的 hard-boundary artifact / OOD artifact 论点。citeturn432817view1 | Goettling, M., Hammer, A., Malberg, H., et al. (2024). *xECGArch: A trustworthy deep learning architecture for interpretable ECG analysis considering short-term and long-term features*. **Scientific Reports, 14**, 13122. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-63656-x | https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-63656-x |
| 扰动算子会改变 explanation 结论 / XAI 方法排名 | Goettling et al. 比较 linear interpolation 与 setting-to-zero 后发现，不同 perturbation scheme 会让不同 XAI 方法看起来更优；zero perturbation 下 ITG 表现最好，而 interpolation 下 DTD 更可信。适合支撑“perturbation operator 本身应被审计”。citeturn432817view2turn432817view1 | Goettling, M., Hammer, A., Malberg, H., et al. (2024). *xECGArch: A trustworthy deep learning architecture for interpretable ECG analysis considering short-term and long-term features*. **Scientific Reports, 14**, 13122. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-63656-x | https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-63656-x |
| 生物医学时序信号 occlusion 中常见 zero-value window occlusion，且包括 ECG 实验 | Resta et al. 提出用于 biomedical signals 的 occlusion explanation，说明 windowed occlusion 中使用 zero values；其 PTBDB 分类实验是 ECG-only，并比较 zero 与 mean occlusion。citeturn612012view3 | Resta, M., Monreale, A., & Bacciu, D. (2021). *Occlusion-Based Explanations in Deep Recurrent Models for Biomedical Signals*. **Entropy, 23**(8), 1064. https://doi.org/10.3390/e23081064 | https://www.mdpi.com/1099-4300/23/8/1064 |
| cardiac / ECG XAI 中解释评估不足，很多研究没有系统量化 explanation quality | Salih et al. 对 cardiac AI XAI evaluation 的综述显示，43% 的研究完全没有评估所用 XAI，只有部分研究使用专家、proxy 或统计分析评价解释质量。适合支撑“影响 seldom quantified / rarely audited”。citeturn700087view3turn937226view0 | Salih, A. M., Galazzo, I. B., Gkontra, P., et al. (2024). *A review of evaluation approaches for explainable AI with applications in cardiology*. **Artificial Intelligence Review, 57**, 240. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10462-024-10852-w | https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10462-024-10852-w |
